"Noah, open your eyes! This can't be your last. Please…!"

Was there ever a greater tragedy than love turned to hate? Such is the tragic downfall of Emperor Ludwig of Berzantium, as he is betrayed and murdered in a fiery blaze by his empress. description.en:
Born as an imperial princess, Arnoah was forced to marry the pathetic young king of a small neighboring kingdom. Her older brother became the emperor, so what was she supposed to do? And due to the laws of inheritance, even if her older brother and younger brother were to die, she would still not inherit the throne - rather, her good-for-nothing cheater of a husband would!! Any title she inherits would be vested in her husband in accordance to their marriage contract... that is, until he decides to divorce her because his mistress wants to be the official queen.

“I need to get divorced and become the emperor.”

Her now official ex-husband still doesn't seem to get it, so she decided to finally tell him everything she always wanted to say to his face. When he realized the truth, it was already too late. She spoke to her ex-husband who had his mouth agape.

“I told you to keep your head straight. Didn’t you hear me?”

---
Revenge is sweet. Divorce? Even sweeter.

Arnoa is trapped in a loveless marriage in which she has sacrificed both her heart and dignity. In the midst of such matrimonial misery, she receives the chance to claim the Empire as her own. There's just one catch: she needs a divorce to make it happen! Will she succeed in getting the last laugh?

description.fr:
Arnoa, princesse impériale s’est vu forcée à épouser un pitoyable roi d’un pays voisin. Sous l’ordre de son frère, l’empereur avec qui elle entretient une relation conflictuelle.

«Je vous aime, Larissa.»

«Vous semblez si heureuse.»

Arnoa se moquait que son mari ait une liaison avec une prostituée ou non. La seule chose qu’elle attendait était la mort… Un jour, son frère aîné perdit la vie de manière inattendue. Dorénavant Arnoa a une raison de vivre: devenir l’impératrice du royaume. Comment va-t-elle faire pour se débarrasser de son mari? Et de quelle manière va-t-elle faire face aux différents obstacles qui vont se dresser devant elle?

---
Le divorce? Encore plus exquis que la vengeance.

Arnoa est prisonnière d'un mariage sans amour marqué par la trahison, la souffrance et l’humiliation. Un jour, la chance de pouvoir s’approprier l’empire et retrouver sa liberté s’offre à elle. Mais il y a un hic: elle doit divorcer pour pouvoir devenir Impératrice! Parviendra-t-elle à ses fins?
description.ko: "탑에 갇혀 자란 황제의 이복동생이자 황녀인 아르노아. 정략결혼으로 겨우 황제의 감시에서 벗어났다고 생각했지만. “나, 바이나스 로체 디르한은 그대와의 이혼을 선언한다.” 2년간의 짧고도 길었던 결혼 생활의 끝에 남겨진 건, 일방적인 이혼 뿐. “……분명하네. 이혼.” 꾹 다물렸던 아르노아의 입술이 열리고 조용한 목소리가 들려왔다. 모두들 그녀의 눈물을 기다렸지만, “이제라도 끝내 줘서 고마워. 2년 동안 정말 많이 참았거든.” 황제의 전령, 무시무시한 소문을 끌고 다니는 제국의 그 마탑주가 그녀의 말과 함께 나타나 누구도 예상치 못한 말을 하는데, “고개를 숙여라. 대륙의 새 주인, 아르노아 살리에드 카이시온 황제다.” 이혼을 위해 모인 자리에서 웃고 있는 것은 오직 그녀 뿐이었다."
description.ru:
Арноа - сводная сестра императора, выросшая в заточении.

Она думала, что наконец-то стала свободной благодаря браку по расчёту.

«Я, Байнас Роше Дирхан, требую развода».

Итогом короткого, но в то же время невыносимо долгого двухлетнего брака стал развод в одностороннем порядке.

«…Ясно. Развод так развод».

На миг Арноа плотно сжала губы - все ожидали, что она вот-вот заплачет, но вместо этого она тихо произнесла:

«Спасибо. Я многое пережила за время своего замужества».

Посланник императора, хозяин магической башни Империи, за которым тянутся ужасные слухи, появляется по её зову говорит то, чего никто не предполагал услышать:

«Преклони голову. Она - новая хозяйка континента, императрица Арноа Саллиэд Кайсион».

На собрании лишь её лицо озаряла улыбка.

Ela não tinha escolha a não ser fazer o que mandavam. Mesmo que seu marido estivesse tendo um caso com as damas de companhia dela, ela não tinha o que fazer. Mas então, seu irmão mais velho e seu segundo irmão morreram, a próxima imperatriz seria a Arnoa…? Não, seria o marido inútil dela. Todos os títulos que ela herdasse enquanto estivesse casada, seriam concedidos ao seu marido. description.en:
I was described as the short-lived childhood friend who turned the male lead into a tyrant in the novel. I died on his behalf, as the novel said. I thought I could now return to my original world. …But why am I back to the age of ten? Is there something wrong with the original story? I can’t help it! I thought I would succeed this time and go back to reality… This tyrant dream is too realistic to be true!

“I don’t care about the throne.”

“What?”

What is it? Did I say this before my regression?

“What are you talking about? Becoming emperor…”

You should meet the heroine and the original story should go on. That way I can go back!

“Viche,” Jade was calling me somewhere with a low voice, “I can’t let you go… for whatever reason.”

There was a soft smile behind Jade’s bleak eyes. …I think he knows something.

---
A young Korean woman is reincarnated inside a novel as Viche Amelian, who according to the story, is to be executed in place of the young prince Jade for assassinating the emperor. After facing her death, she expects to get her old life back, but instead wakes up as a ten-year-old Viche! Could it be that her death failed to turn Jade into a tyrant, as the story foretold? Viche must now figure out where she went wrong, and make sure that this time, Jade becomes the world’s most wicked tyrant!

Я думала, что мы станем семьей, но это было всего лишь моими несбыточными мечтами.

Я попросила развод, потому что устала от холодного обращения мужа, который заботится только о своей младшей сестре и не может с ней расстаться.

— Развод? Конечно нет! Разве нам было плохо, когда мы были вместе?

— Невестка, подумай еще раз!

В отличие от прошлого, теперь я полна решимости.

— Тогда могу ли я получить обратно шахту, которая является моим приданым?

— Подожди минутку, невестка.

Нет необходимости думать об этом снова.

Но мой муж происходит из могущественной герцогской семьи. Мне нужна помощь злодея из оригинальной истории.

— Кто, черт возьми, доставил тебе неприятности?

Разве этот человек не слишком драгоценен, чтобы главная героиня причиняла ему боль...?

— Единственный человек, которого я хочу иметь рядом с собой, это ты, Эдель.

……он на моей стороне?
description.vi:
Tôi đã chiếm hữu cơ thể của Ethel trong một cuốn tiểu thuyết yêu thích của tôi. Và tôi đã kết hôn cùng anh trai nữ chính Riena.

Tưởng chừng như chúng tôi sẽ tự nhiên mà chung sống hòa thuận với nhau, nhưng đó là sai lầm khi nghĩ như vậy. Anh ta chỉ quan tâm đến em gái của mình và tôi quyết định ly hôn với anh ta vì quá mệt mỏi với người chồng lạnh lùng nhưng chỉ dịu dàng với Reina.

“Ly hôn gì ở đây? Tuyệt đối không được. Không phải vào lúc hẹn hò đã rất tuyệt à?”

“Chị dâu, hãy nghĩ kỹ lại đi mà”

Không như trước đây, tôi đã quyết tâm hoàn toàn.

“Vậy tôi sẽ quay lại khi có của hồi môn là mỏ vàng được chứ?”

“Chị dâu, khoan đã”

…Ly hôn không cần suy nghĩ thêm nữa!

Nhưng đối thủ của tôi là một công tước. Vậy nên, tôi cần cho mình một người trợ thủ và đó là nhân vật phản diện trong nguyên tác.

“Ai dám bắt nạt em?”

Người đàn ông này sẽ bị hủy hoại dưới bàn tay của Reina, điều đó không phải quá đáng quá sao…?

Elena Rode kommt mit der Erinnerungen an ihr vorheriges Leben auf die Welt.
Da sie in ihrem vorherigen Leben die Zukunft der Rode-Familie, in der sie jetzt als jüngste Tochter geboren wurde, bereits in einem Roman gelesen hat, weiß sie, dass ihr Vater, der Graf Rode, für seine Boshaft bekannt ist. Eines Tages zieht Sirius Hiperion, der Bruder des aktuellen Kaisers und der Nachkomme des Wolfs, als Schüler des Grafen bei der Rode-Familie ein. Elena weiss ebenfalls, dass Sirius nicht einfach von Person ist und wie seine Zukunft aussehen wird. Doch er verhält sich anders als Elenas Vorkenntnisse und seine Zuneigung zu ihr werden allmählich stärker. Wird die Zukunft von Elena tatsächlich so voranschreiten, wie sie es im Roman gelesen hat?

What's so great about being the daughter of a duke anyway? 

As the youngest child of a crazy duke with no empathy for his kids, Elena wants to live quietly and avoid her family’s bullying. But when she ends up being followed by Sirius Hyperion, the illegitimate child of the emperor and the person foretold to bring down her family, Elena decides to sit back and watch their demise. 

But will sticking with Sirius allow Elena to break free from her family, or will she become one of his many victims?

description.zh: 穿进小说的娇软萝莉艾蕾娜一心只想做“废物”，却被疯批正太黏上？！拜托，这可是长大后主打复仇和杀戮的男主！明知道不应该和他过于亲近，但看着弱小的他受伤、痛苦，完全无法放任不管啊。既然是男主的话，只要待在他身边，就算做个“废物“，应该也能好好活下去吧......

description.en:
The East. The cursed land where the sun never rises, always engulfed in dreary weather, swarmed with criminals, and where depression is the norm. And the monster who governs over this land is the Duke of Eckard. Hedel, who was on the verge of marrying her cousin, receives a marriage proposal from this monster Duke. Although everyone opposes her, Hedel had no choice but to accept the Duke's proposal...

"I've never had this kind of food before!"

"Ever since Madam's arrival, the sun seems to always set here...!"

"The East can never live without Madam anymore."

It seems Hedel has done very well in taming the people from the East. This is the story of Hedel occupying the East, which starts with a marriage.

---
With her family deep in debt, Hedel Argetnta was looking for any way out of her disastrous situation. Her only option? Marrying the wealthy but monstrous duke of the east, Cassian Ekarde, a total stranger. Upon her arrival in the East, she learns it is a cursed land infested with criminals, and that her new home is full of dangerous servants. Determined to turn things around, Hedel starts to make changes but finds out that the cause of all this mess might be none other than the man she married.
description.es:
Siempre clima sombrío, infestado de delincuentes, y la depresión es la norma -la tierra maldita donde nunca sale el sol, el Este.
Y el monstruo que gobierna allí, Duke Eckard.
Hedel, que estaba a punto de casarse con su primo, recibe una propuesta del duque de los monstruos. Todos se oponen, pero Hedel no tiene más remedio que aceptar la propuesta del duque… … .
“¡Esta es la primera vez que he comido comida como esta!”
“Siempre puedo ver el sol después de que vino mi madre… … !”
“Oriente ya no puede vivir sin Madame”.
¿Domaste a la gente de Oriente mejor de lo que pensabas?
Comenzando con el matrimonio, la historia de Hedel sobre sus ocupaciónes del Este.
***
“¿Entonces quieres decir que hiciste un buen trabajo?”
El trueno tronó a sus espaldas con el grito de Hedel.
El cielo despejado se oscureció de repente, y de repente llovió mucho.
“… … .”
Confundido, Cassian miró a Hedel sin decir nada.
Antes de que pudiera atraparlo, Hedel abandonó inmediatamente el estudio.
Después de un rato, se escuchó un fuerte golpe.
Preguntándose si era Hedel, Cassian rápidamente corrió y abrió la puerta.
Entonces los sirvientes, incluido el mayordomo, entraron en tropel.
“¿Qué diablos dijiste que hizo enojar a tu señora?”
“El clima estuvo muy agradable hoy… … !”
Todos gritaron juntos.
“¡Por favor, dile al diablo que estás equivocado!”
Casiano suspiró.
Después de que Hedel se casara, era responsabilidad de Cassian que lloviera en el este.
description.fr: Hedel Argenta qui est dans une situation désespérée à cause de son cousin cupide, se voit offrir une proposition de mariage inattendue de la part du duc Cassian Ekard. Cependant, une étrange malédiction semble frapper les terres du duc, où seuls la pluie, le brouillard et des nuages gris traversent l'Est. Or, il est dit que quand le joyau du dragon retournera, le soleil de nouveau, se lèvera. Et mystérieusement, depuis qu'Hedel est arrivée, le beau temps est revenu. De plus, lorsqu'elle vit le visage de son époux pour la première fois, de mystérieuses écailles bleues parcouraient sa peau. Mais que se passe-t-il ici?

description.en:
“The Blessing of Heaven”, “A Prodigal Genius”, “Edenberg’s Dog”  
  
To win the love of her adopted parents, Elena dedicated her skills to the Edenberg name. If anything posed to harm the family, Elena would even kill the people she loved. In the end, Elena’s “family” chose to sacrifice her. No longer having the will to live, Elena’s dying wish was to destroy the Edenberg family name. Time reset and Elena now has a chance to do just that with the help of the mysterious Emperor who heard her wish.  
  
————————————  
  
A family not connected by blood but with ink. I do not desire these abilities of mine. I only want love from them however, they cruelly used everything I had and abandoned me at the end.  
  
I was offered as a sacrifice.  
“Those eyes.”  
Before death approached after I was sacrificed, I met him.  
“You have no will to live.”  
He breathed in the scent from my neck as if it was the most fragrant thing.  
“Your last wishes, child.”  
  
Those were the last words I heard in this life. I thought that moment was extremely awful. If only I was allowed to live one more time. Then. This time I will throw you people away first. Like a miracle, I returned to the past.  
  
“I come to pick you up.”  
“……”  
“Really, it has been a while, isn’t it?”  
I met him again.

Her peaceful life that was different from her previous life was cut short. Astina was sold to Grand Duke Theodore due to her father’s bankruptcy, however, Grand Duke Theodore lived in the form of a beast…

“He got hit and fainted. It’s not a serious injury so he’ll quickly regain consciousness.”

“He… fainted?”

Contrary to everyone’s expectations of her dying in one night, she began to tame the monster Theodore with her fancy swordwork, and tame it as a pet.

“Theo, sit.”

“Woof!”

But one night after telling Theodore how talented he is, she kissed him for just a second…

“…Theo?”

Astina’s wild beast… became human?
  
A full-fledged romance between the deficient monster husband and the thoughtless wife!
description.es:
Cien años después de la muerte de la legendaria figura Martina, la madre del imperio, Martina renace como Astina, una noble. Vida pasada y otras rutinas pacíficas, en un momento, Theodore fue vendido a Astina en forma de bestia…… A diferencia de la expectativa de todos de morir aquella noche, ella comienza a domar al monstruo Theodore y lo domestica como su mascota. "Theo, siéntate". "Wof!" Pero una noche lo besó por un corto tiempo… "……¿Theo?" La mascota de Astina…… Era una persona ¡Un auténtico romance de entrenamiento de un pobre esposo monstruo y una esposa arrogante!

Everyone dreams of knocking out their insufferable boss, but what if that boss is a war hero, a duke, and constantly breathing down your neck? For Chloe, enduring Curtis's relentless inspections was a daily struggle... Until a royal marriage decree offers her an unexpected way out.

---
Everyone has had the urge to punch their infuriating boss, but actually going through with it is hard. Especially when that boss is a war hero and a grand duke, no less. Chloe could only grit her teeth as she watched Curtis constantly conduct service inspections… but then, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presented itself. The king ordered Curtis to marry a noblewoman from another country, and he put forward his lieutenant, Chloe, as his lover. Now, the gun was in her hands… “First, get on your knees, Your Grace.”

게다가 그 상사가 전쟁 영웅, 게다가 대공이라면. 
복무점검을 시도때도 없이 시전하는 커티스를 보며 클로이는 그저 이를 악물 뿐이었는데… 
그런 그녀에게 다시없을 기회가 왔다. 

타국의 귀족과 정략결혼하라는 국왕의 명령에 
커티스가 옆에 있던 부관인 클로이를 연인으로 내세운 것이다. 

이제 총은 클로이의 손에 있으니… 
“일단, 꿇어보시죠. 대공 각하.”
description.ru:
У каждого из нас возникало желание ударить начальника, который нас бесит, но сделать это трудно. Особенно когда этот начальник – герой войны, да еще и эрцгерцог. Хлое остается только скрипеть зубами, наблюдая, как Кертис снова и снова назначает дисциплинарные наказания... Но теперь ей выпал шанс, который больше никогда не представится.
Из-за приказа короля жениться на аристократке из другой страны Кертис выбрал в любовницы Хлою, своего лейтенанта.
Теперь оружие в ее руках...
«Для начала преклоните колени, Ваша Светлость».
description.tr: Herkes sinir bozucu bir patrona yumruk atma isteği duyar, ancak bunu başarmak hiç de kolay değildir. Hele ki o patron bir savaş kahramanı ve üstelik bir de baş arşidük ise durum daha da vahim. Curtis'in sürpriz servis denetimlerini izleyen Chloe, dişlerini sıkmaktan başka bir şey yapamadı... Ancak daha sonra, hayatında bir kez karşılaşacağı bir fırsat karşısına çıktı. Kral, yabancı bir soyluyla siyasi bir evlilik emri verdiğinde Curtis, yardımcısı Chloe'yi ortağı olarak tanıttı. Artık silah Chloe'nin elinde... "Önce diz çökün, Majesteleri Arşidük."
description.uk:
Кожен має боса, якого хочеться прибити. Але зазвичай просто... Не можна.

"Як прикро, офіцерко Амбуаз".

Особливо, якщо ваш бос, не абихто, а Великий Герцог Кертіс Шенберг, другий у черзі на престол, ще й відомий герой. 

Хлоя Амбуаз щодня стикалася з такою реальністю і соромом, але нарешті з'явилася чудова нагода.

Король, прагнучи приструнити зростаючу владу Великого Герцога, наказав йому одружитися з іноземкою-дворянкою. 

"Ми з Хлоєю Амбуаз нещодавно почали зустрічатися".

"З-зі мною?"

Скориставшись моментом, Великий Герцог Берг збрехав і назвав Хлою, незначну ад'ютантку, своєю коханкою. 

"...Це правда. Його світлість нещодавно зробив мені пропозицію".

Хлоя миттєво підіграла Великому Герцогові. Звичайно, у неї були свої приховані наміри. 

Ось так, ігноруючи справжні наміри одне одного, Хлоя і Великий Герцог Кертіс раптом зрозуміли, що їх позиціонують наймогутнішою парою королівства.

"Дякую. Я дам тобі все, чого забажаєш."

"Так!" Обличчя Хлої Амбуаз засяяло так, що її очі перетворилися на два півмісяці.

"Тоді спочатку..."

"...."

"На коліна, Ваша Світлосте."

"Не хочете? Вам це не до вподоби? Якщо не подобається, то одружіться зі мною".

Обличчя найвродливішого чоловіка королівства скривилося через дві опції. 

Вона ледь не плакала від захвату.

description.de: Nach dem Tod ihres Zieh-Großvaters ist die zehnjährige Katisha plötzlich Alleinerbin eines enormen Vermögens. Doch ihre Geschichte als unbedeutende Randfigur eines Romans ist damit leider noch lange nicht vorbei: Nicht nur muss sie sich gegen die berüchtigte Familie des Herzogs Blasco behaupten, sondern auch mit einem magischen Schwert fertigwerden, das sie ins Verderben stürzen könnte. Ihr Schicksal ähnelt immer mehr dem der eigentlichen Hauptfigur des Romans...
description.en:
Ten years after being reincarnated as an extra in a novel. The day my grandfather, the owner of the house where I grew up, died, of the infamous ducal family of Blasco.

"His Excellency the Grand Duke bequeathed all his assets to the girl Katisha."
"His Highness the Grand Duke."

So my grandfather is the Duke of Blasco? I am struck by the enormity of the inheritance, but it is impossible for "the" Duke of Blasko to leave me alone, even because we are related!

"No, thanks..."
"Cash, excluding inheritance tax and personal deposits at the central bank. You can keep everything else in Blasco's name."
"I want!!!"

소설 속 엑스트라로 환생한 지 10년차.
날 거둬 키워주신 집 주인 할아버지가 돌아가신 날,
악명 높은 공작 가문 '블라스코'에서 찾아왔다.

"선대 공작 각하께서 카티샤 양께 모든 유산을 상속하셨습니다."

그니까 할아버지가 '블라스코' 공작 각하였다구요?!
어마어마한 유산을 물려받아 기쁜 것도 잠시,

description.ru:
Дедушке Герцену подбросили маленькую девочку, и ему ничего не оставалось, кроме как вырастить её. Так и началось моё перерождение в романе десять лет назад.
Но в день смерти дедушки меня настигла неожиданная весть: на похороны явились люди из печально известного герцогского дома Власко.
– Согласно завещанию покойного герцога, всё его состояние переходит леди Катише.
– Покойного герцога?!
Оказывается, дедушка был герцогом Власко! Я была ошеломлена не только огромным наследством, но и осознанием того, что меня, десятилетнюю девочку, так просто не отпустят.
– Я отказываюсь ехать с вами!
– Вам полагаются все наличные деньги, а также вещи и доходы с территорий.
– Хорошо, давайте скорее ехать!
Я стала десятилетним миллионером, поэтому должна защитить свои богатства!

description.en: When portals called “gates” opened in 1997, humanity was thrown into chaos as monsters ravaged the planet. Countless lives were lost, including Eunha Cha’s mother. Left to fend for herself, Eunha one day mysteriously awakens a new power. Drafted into the military to fight alongside other Hunters, she sets out on what was supposed to be a routine mission inside a C-rank gate. But when she becomes trapped inside, she’s forced to fight relentlessly against waves of monsters as the gate resets endlessly... until a voice calls out to her.
description.fr: En 1997, notre monde bascule dans le chaos quand surgissent aux quatre coins de la planète de mystérieux portails, entrées de donjons renfermant de terribles monstres. Par miracle, ce phénomène entraîne «l'éveil» des chasseurs, des surhumains dôtés de pouvoirs magiques. Cha eun-ha n'est qu'une adolescente lorsque sa mère meurt suite à l'apparition des portails. Elle n'est qu'une jeune adulte lorsqu'elle se retrouve enfermée dans un donjon qui ne suit pas les règles habituelles...

Cha Eunha yang baru saja kehilangan ibunya, termasuk salah satu 'awakener' yang dimasukkan ke dalam militer untuk bertarung melawan monster. Di salah satu sesi latihannya, dia terjebak seorang diri di dalam gate dan harus terus berjuang melawan para monster. Hingga suatu hari, dia kedatangan 'teman kecil' yang membantunya bertahan hidup.
description.ko:
비밀에 싸인 언노운 게이트에서 실종됐던 1세대 헌터 차은하가 돌아온다. 새까만 드레스와 양산을 든 그녀는 동료를 구하고 게이트 안에 남아야만 했다.  
몬스터를 해치우며 생존해온 차은하 앞에 우연히 나타난 인간. 그리고 드디어 은하는 현실세상으로 돌아오게 되는데... “30년 후의 세상에 오신 걸 환영합니다, 선배.” 은하의 앞에 펼쳐진 것은 30년 후의 세상이었다.
description.ru:
Ын-Ха Ча, охотница первого поколения, пропавшая без вести в тайных Неизвестных Вратах, возвращается. Одетая в черное платье и держа в руках зонтик, она должна была спасти своих товарищей и остаться в воротах.
Человек, случайно появившийся перед Ын-ха Ча, которая выжила, победив монстров. И наконец, Ын-ха возвращается в реальный мир...
«Добро пожаловать в мир 30 лет спустя, сеньора».
Перед Ынхой развернулся мир, произошедший через 30 лет.
description.th: ชาอึนฮา นักล่ารุ่นแรก หายตัวไปอย่างไร้ร่องรอยหลังจากที่เธอเข้าไปใน 'เกตลึกลับ' เธอเลือกที่จะอยู่ที่นั่นเพื่อคอยช่วยเหลือเพื่อนร่วมทีมของเธอ โดยที่ทั้งตัวมีเพียงชุดเดรสสีดำ และร่มในมือ ท่ามกลางโลกที่เต็มไปด้วยมอนสเตอร์ เธอเอาชีวิตรอดเพียงลำพัง ด้วยการฟาดฟันกับมอนสเตอร์ซ้ำแล้วซ้ำเล่า จนวันหนึ่ง ได้มีมนุษย์คนหนึ่ง ปรากฏตัวตรงหน้าเธออย่างไม่คาดฝัน และในที่สุด… ชาอึนฮา ก็ได้กลับมายังโลกความจริงอีกครั้ง แต่โลกที่เธอกลับมาคือโลกในอีก 30 ปีให้หลัง "ยินดีต้อนรับสู่โลกในอีกสามสิบปีต่อมาค่ะ รุ่นพี่" โลกอนาคตที่ทั้งเปลี่ยนไปแต่ก็ยังคงเดิม ชาอึนฮาจะสามารถหาเส้นทางเดินในชีวิตของเธอได้อีกครั้งหรือไม่?
description.zh-hk: 在神祕未知的「不明之門」中失蹤的第一代獵人——車銀河，回來了！ 手持黑色洋傘、身穿黑裙的她，曾為了拯救同伴而選擇留在門內。 在不斷獵殺怪物、掙扎求生的日子裡，她偶然遇見了一名人類。 而她，終於回到了現實世界—— 「歡迎來到30年後的世界，前輩！」

description.en:
When the emperor declared that his children must battle to become the last remaining heir, the only way Princess Lisbelle could survive was by becoming a mad woman. Feigning insanity kept her out of danger for years, but with only three children remaining, Lisbelle now finds herself a target. In a moment of danger, she discovers powers gifted to her by the goddess Hellare and suddenly finds herself in the company of a charming magician. But whether he’s friend or foe has yet to be determined…

---
"On the Moonlight Garden-! White evening primroses are in full bloom -!"

A strange succession ceremony has all princes and princesses fight each other as only the strongest member of the royal family may succeed the throne. After being poisoned to death, she returned five years into the past and decided to played the part of a crazy b*tch in order to survive. Yet somehow looking like the weakest was still not enough. The crazy princess, with no power or backing, was about to die yet again, but a suspicious wizard suddenly appeared before her.

"What should I do to get your kiss?"

"A deal. If you help me, I'll kiss you."

"Good. I have no intention of letting you die in the hands of anyone besides me."

I feel like I entered the tiger's den while trying to escape the wolves… Is it really okay if I make this deal? A fiery battle and romance between a woman walking towards life with all her might, and a man who lives for death.

description.en:
Demons came pouring from a portal that appeared out of nowhere and caused the Cataclysm. But all hope is not lost thanks to the Awakeners, people who can fight these demons. 

Lee Jun, a D-rank Awakener, is one of them. He fought demons heroically, but as someone who inherited nothing from his family, he could only go so far. 

As Jun Lee’s life slowly whittled away, a system message appeared, informing him that a special martial arts route had opened...

When Yihwan woke up, the world had changed.

Zombies roamed the streets, thirsting for human blood, while the living fought desperately to survive.

But… 

"Why aren't the zombies biting me?"

With an unnatural strength surging through his body, one eye glowing red like the undead, and a strange hunger rising at the sight of blood...

"What... happened to me?!

Lee Gi-Ho is trying to earn his tuition through the popular VR game Circuit, but things just aren't going his way. However, right when he decides to throw in the towel, he gets a lucky break that changes everything!

Fortune leads him ever deeper into the game’s lore, and before he knows it, Gi-Ho finds himself stocked up with powerful items chasing an elusive group of mysterious warriors. 

But to unlock his true powers, Giho must learn the secrets of this group before his luck runs out for good.

I was the one abandoned, yet I seem to have grown up the most mentally stable! 

I was ordered to serve my fake counterpart as her maid, so I decided to go undercover. But something's off with my former family. Whatever, it's not my problem! So, I just focused on my task... 

"Are you really not going to live with us?"

The eldest, who used to show obsessive control over the fake, started acting strangely toward me. 
"I never thought I’d feel such camaraderie and trust with the opposite sex. You’re strangely too comfortable." 

The second brother, who was on the brink of falling into darkness, managed to get back on track thanks to me. 
"I didn’t come here to help them film their regret-filled family drama." 

I tried to ignore everything and quickly moved on to my next mission… but why do I keep running into people whose lives are completely messed up? 

Why is everyone in perfect need of saving?

"같이 안 살 거니?"

가짜에게 통제욕 보이던 첫째는 나한테 헛짓거리를 하질 않나.

"이성에게 이런 동료애와 신뢰감을 느낄 줄은 몰랐어. 자네는 이상하게 너무 편해."

description.en:
Extras die every day in various ways in the game [Demon King’s Palace 3].

He was an extra when he reincarnated into the game.

I’ll never die. Never.

“Let’s get started.”

Evan had come to a conclusion.

He tapped his cheeks as a way of signaling to himself that he had made up his mind.

He would become a character who never dies.
description.fr:
Dans le jeu à succès [Great Demon War 3], il existe un PNJ dont la mort prend toutes sortes de tournures différentes, quoi qu’il arrive.

Bien que ce soit un personnage sans grande importance, il a toujours eu une animation de mort pour chaque scénario possible. Le nom de ce célèbre personnage est “Evan D. Sherden” !
…Et c’est le nom que je porte après avoir été réincarné dans le monde de ce jeu. Bordel !

Je ne me suis pas réincarné en tant que protagoniste, mais en tant que simple PNJ qui meurt sans arrêt.
Je ne peux pas mourir comme ça !
Je dois survivre, quoi qu’il arrive !

Je… serai un PNJ qui ne mourra jamais !

The problem is... "Then, what'll happen to my daughter in this 'tragic novel'?" "...What? Ten male leads?" “The price of turnips has dropped again.”

“Firewood…”

Wait a minute… I don’t know anything about managing an estate!

“I think we should hire a magician to work in the estate.”

Just when she thought there was no way out, she gets help from the head of the magic tower… but something about this man seems suspicious.

“Want to touch it?”
“Touch what?”
“My hair. You’ve been staring at it since last time, you wanted to touch it, didn’t you?”

The head of the magic tower, the kind-hearted, dog-loving second male lead, seems a bit off this time.

Maybe I should just run away from the estate.

Alice was a chef living in Korea when an explosion transported her into a novel. Having worked so hard in her previous life only to die young, Alice wants to live this new life in peace. There’s only one problem: her mother-in-law is trying to frame her for the murder of her husband. Using her knowledge of the novel, can Alice subvert the original plot into something that might allow her to live in peace, or is she doomed to live as the caretaker of a comatose husband until her death?
___
"The deadline is six months, within which you must kill your husband."

On the first night of their marriage, I possessed the body of 'Alice,' a villainous supporting character who was ordered by her mother-in-law to kill her husband.

I thought I was married off to a duke who's a living  corpse for the sake of money, but lo and behold, this duke has a great body and is handsome as well. Instead of killing him, I looked for a way to survive by using divine power instead of poison.

"Mother, I will become a priestess for the duke!
As a priestess, I shall pray for the duke's well-being for the rest of my life!"

On the day I was about to leave the duke's mansion, my husband who had been unconscious suddenly woke up.

"You're the one who brought me out of the darkness, so take responsibility."

He wakes up and demands I take responsibility after saving him?
description.fr: Projetée dans un roman fantastique, elle se réveille dans le corps d'Alice et se voit confier une mission bien particulière: assassiner son mari sur ordre de sa belle-mère. Consciente du sort qui l'attend si elle lui obéit, elle décide de tout faire pour le sauver... ou au moins pour rester en vie.
description.hu: Alice szakácsként élt Koreában, amikor egy robbanás egy regénybe repítette. Miután előző életében olyan keményen dolgozott, hogy fiatalon halt meg, Alice békében szeretné élni ezt az új életet. Csak egy probléma van: az anyósa megpróbálja őt vádolni férje meggyilkolásával. A regényben szerzett ismeretei alapján Alice képes-e az eredeti cselekményt olyanná alakítani, ami lehetővé teszi számára a békét, vagy arra van ítélve, hogy kómában fekvő férje gondozójaként éljen haláláig?
description.id: "Tenggat waktunya adalah enam bulan, di mana kamu harus membunuh suamimu." Pada malam pertama pernikahan mereka, saya merasuki tubuh 'Alice', karakter pendukung jahat yang diperintahkan oleh ibu mertuanya untuk membunuh suaminya. Saya pikir saya dinikahkan dengan seorang bangsawan yang merupakan mayat hidup demi uang, tetapi lihatlah, bangsawan ini memiliki tubuh yang bagus dan juga tampan. Alih-alih membunuhnya, saya mencari cara untuk bertahan hidup dengan menggunakan kekuatan ilahi, bukan racun. "Ibu, aku akan menjadi pendeta wanita untuk sang duke! Sebagai seorang pendeta wanita, aku akan berdoa untuk kesejahteraan sang adipati selama sisa hidupku!" Pada hari aku akan meninggalkan rumah bangsawan, suamiku yang tidak sadarkan diri tiba-tiba terbangun. "Kaulah yang membawaku keluar dari kegelapan, jadi bertanggung jawablah." Dia terbangun dan menuntut saya untuk bertanggung jawab setelah menyelamatkannya?

description.ru:
У тебя есть шесть месяцев, чтобы убить своего мужа».
В первую ночь после свадьбы она завладела телом Алисы, второстепенной героини, убившей своего мужа по приказу свекрови.
Думала, меня продали и выдали замуж за герцога, похожего на живой труп, но почему он такой красивый?! Вместо того, чтобы убивать, я использовала божественную силу, чтобы излечить его от яда и найти способ выжить.
«Мама, я стану священником для герцога! Стану новым жрецом и буду молиться о его благополучии всю жизнь!»
Но в день, когда я собиралась покинуть поместье, мой муж внезапно проснулся.
«Ты была той, кто вытащил меня из тьмы. Возьми за это ответственность».
Я спасла его жизнь, поэтому он хочет, чтобы я взяла ответственность за это?

With the party leader missing an arm and the only healer a quivering mess, can Jinwoo some­how find them a way out?

description.en:
Isabelle is an orphan living in a temple with lots of knowledge about the love between men and women thanks to red covered novels that the saints had sneaked in.

But then, she found out that a priest secretly sold her to be a one-night stand for the duke who kills his lovers due to the shame of his inability to perform…

There’s only one way to get out of this, and it is to be a married woman.

At that moment, Isabelle recalled her childhood friend, Riggs, who said he wasn’t interested in dating.

“So, Riggs, marry me.”

“…What?”

“Nobles would refuse unless it’s a pure woman.”

“…Why do you hate the Duke of Cardiago so much?”

“Everything else is fine. Being a tyrant? If you’ve lived your life to the fullest, that could happen. But there can be no problems at night.”

Riggs was so frustrated that it seemed like he was going crazy.

A few days later, the reclusive Duke of Cardiago came to the temple.

Of course, the most surprising thing to Isabelle was the true identity of her childhood friend.

“Isabelle, you wanted to get married. You can’t say no because you proposed first. I’m the closest man to your ideal type anyway.”

“My ideal type?”

“Don’t I know your ideal type? You like guys who are tall, handsome, smell of soap at night, and sleep in simple clothes. Also, on the first night, the bed should break.”

“…”

“That’s everything, and I can do it all for you. So marry me.”

She once knew everything about her childhood friend, but that changed the moment they got married.

“Riggs, slow down…”

“I think I’m slow enough.”

“You weren’t always this impatient.”

Isabelle said pleadingly, but Riggs replied with a smirk.

“I was a childhood friend then, but now I’m your husband.”

---
Isabelle has always dreamed of meeting her true love and living happily ever after. Unfortunately, she discovers that she was just sold to the monstrous Duke Cardiego, who's infamous for killing his bride candidates. Although she tells him she will just stay a friend, Lix begins to show her that he doesn't feel the same way. Will their friendship be able to last through this matrimony?

Во-первых, буду слушаться во всем мачеху и сводную сестру.   
Во-вторых, сближусь с детьми из влиятельных семей.
